summary.text: Lynn Chapman is the Independent American Party candidate for U.S. House Nevada District 2 and the party's treasurer in Nevada. Chapman also ran for the seat in 2024, finishing third with about 5 percent of the vote. Little other biographical information is publicly available.

paragraphs.text: The Nevada Independent's 2026 voter guide lists Chapman as treasurer of the Nevada Independent American Party.
Ran for U.S. House Nevada District 2 in 2024 as an Independent American Party candidate, receiving 19,784 votes (5.0 percent) in the general election won by incumbent Mark Amodei.
